The Vienna BioCenter is a life-sciences campus, not a data centre, so the match to this brief is weak. I found an opening year but no whole-campus floor area.

**Year:** The operator's history page places the campus's start in 1988, which it describes as the beginning of the Vienna BioCenter (

citations.cited_text: 1988 marked the beginning of the Vienna BioCenter.
citations.title: History

content.text: 1988 marked the beginning of the Vienna BioCenter.

citations.cited_text: Under the directorship of [Max Birnstiel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Max_Birnstiel), the first institute building was opened in 1988.
citations.title: Research Institute of Molecular Pathology

content.text: the first institute building was opened in 1988.

I'm recording 1988 as the year, with the operator's page as the source, though its wording is "beginning" rather than "opened."

**Area:** I found no gross floor area or campus-wide area in the sources. The only area figure is for the Startup Labs, a sub-facility on the campus:
